review_text: I got a 1/4 oz jar (great for travel!) of this from Sephora, using my points. Gel-creams are my favorite kind of moisturizer. I’ve only used this one a few days, just fyi, so I don’t know how it works long term.The smell is so nice, like the face wipes (Truth on the Glow). However, I’ve had a bout of contact dermatitis on my back (not face, thankfully) and the itching and pain have been horrible! This experience has put me on alert to fragrances in products, maybe to the point of being a little paranoid. So, I would rather that this product not have fragrance, even though it’s such a nice one. Also, I’d just as soon get vitamin C from my serum and have a more basic moisturizer. But I’m going to use this along with my vitamin C serum, and just consider it a C boost.

review_text: I hate to say that this product disappointed me. Perhaps it’s my skin, but I’m shocked how many five star ratings this moisturizer has. It wasn’t terrible, it did help with my dry, flaky areas which I suppose is the purpose of a moisturizer. However, it just sat on my skin. I can only put this on at night since it takes so long to absorb into my skin. Any “brightening” effect comes from the product just sitting on my face leaving an oily look. I really wish I had better things to say about this, but it didn’t do much for me than a drugstore moisturizer would. For reference, I have sensitive and porous skin. This sometimes leaves red spots on my face for a short while after. My skin does feel smooth and moisturized come morning, but I sadly won’t purchase again.

review_text: I received this product for review from Influenster, and I was really hoping that it would work. I tried this product a few times in both the morning and night, and both times it worked bad for me. In the morning, it made my skin look very textured and detailed, and brought out all the bumps that I had on my skin, and maybe even created more. It also made my skin feel very oily, even though I have dry skin. Even a half hour after using this, it felt impossible to put my makeup on because it made my skin so textured and oily. At night time, it had the same effects, but when I woke up in the morning my skin was more oily than it had ever been. On the bright side, I love the smell and texture of this, and I think that the packaging is cool, but the product just didn’t meet standards. I’ve revived this product for sampling purposes, but all opinions are my own.

review_text: I received the C-Rush Brightening Gel Crème complimentary to try. I was super excited to try OleHenriksen skincare and I was not disappointed. This moisturizer works so well at moisturizing and brightening. The subtle but nice scent of orange creamsicle is nice. I usually prefer products without fragrance but I like this as is. It is pleasant. At first I noticed my skin was more hydrated. I loved it already. I decided to try Truth Serum after a week using C-Rush. So, I headed to Sephora to buy some. The combination is magical for me. I have some hyper pigmentation spots and they have lightened significantly. My skin looks more youthful and supple. I feel that my face is hydrated all day long. My makeup looks and feels better. On a tip from IG I mixed some C-Rush into my foundation and it added a subtle illumination that is just beautiful. I am definitely planning to stick with this moisturizer and I’m looking forward to trying more from OleHenriksen. While I did receive this for free to try, my opinion is honest and mine.

review_text: First things first - The smell alone is going to make you want to use this over and over again! It’s like a delicious creamsicle on a hot summer day!! I don’t mind using this prior to bedtime and in the daytime if I’m going to put makeup on but I don’t like wearing it in the day without makeup. review_text: I received this as a part of my Influenster Vox Box and was excited to try it out since I was already eyeing OH’s Truth Serum (which I eventually bought and used in conjunction with this). review_text: Okay y’all. I NEVER write reviews but this deserves ALLLLLLLL THE HYPE. My skin is crazy acne prone. I mean I always have at least 2-5 active zits at all times (usually smaller ones but sometimes huge ones on my chin) I’m 21. I’ve tried EVERYTHING. Olay, Farmacy Honey Drop, YTTP Superfood Air Whipped moisture cream, Biossance Squalene Rose Oil & the Probiotic Gel moisturizer, Mario Bedescu, Ole Henricksen, Cerve Ve, Aveeno, Neautrogena, Clinique Dramatically Different, Clinique Moisture Bomb, usually plain ole Sweet Almond Oil, Rosehip Oil, you name it, cheap or expensive, I’ve honestly probably tried it. YTTP ADAPTOGEN DEEP MOISTURIZE CREAM IS THE BEST MOISTURIZER IVE EVER USED. It is the ONLY one that has NEVER caused even one zit. (Given I use this over top of Stridex Sensitive Skin Aloe & Salicylic Acid pads) but my skin has improved ten-fold. The super food moisturizer from YTTP clogged my pores a tiny bit, but the ADAPTOGEN hasn’t at all. I am so overly obsessed. It has oils in it, which usually explode my face into monstrous pimples/acne. Somehow, someway, my beyond sensitive skin hasn’t reacted badly to this at all. When you sleep in it, you wake up with ZERO redness. I don’t notice it helping with the redness as much throughout the day, but sleeping in it does wonders. I still use it morning and evening though, because it is the ONLY moisturizer I can use. I am absolutely obsessed with this cream. My face has NO active pimples or small zits at all (knock on wood) and I’m pretty sure I have this cream to thank for it. Try it, if you don’t like it, keep the receipt and return it. But I doubt you’ll return it lol

review_text: Omg, this moisturizer did what it came to do. I struggle with redness around my mouth area and in between my eyebrows and felt like my skin overall wasn’t getting the hydration it needs. Previously I would apply aquaphor  and facial oil to help seal in more hydration and it would help a bit, but the redness just would not budge. Then I got this product and within two days of using it I saw such a huge difference! That stubborn redness was basically gone overnight. I bought the mini size to try out and once I saw how much my skin loved this, I went and got the regular 2 oz size. I’ve never been more impressed with a product. And the consistency is lovely. It’s thicc with two c’s but melts into the skin so easily. I really love that this is a clean beauty product so I don’t have to worry about any of that weird stuff and no fragrance is the cherry on top. I’m gonna have to try more things from Youth to the People because this is itttt. 10 out of freaking 10.

review_text: Loving this. I have really dry skin, and it only gets drier throughout the day. It feels light on the skin, but keeps me hydrated. I like that the packaging isn’t massive like the first three creams I mentioned.Cons: I could use some more moisture in the afternoon. A tube format might be nice? I don’t like open tubs. My current line up includes:- Morning: Wash with charcoal konjac sponge, Drunk elephant c-firma, yttp adaptogen cream, supergoop zinc screen, makeup (no foundation, just some powders, eyeshadow, and mascara)- Night: pharmacy oil balm, korres yogurt cleanser, charcoal konjac sponge, drunk elephant aha/bha, yttp adaptogen

review_text: I would have been blown away with this moisturizer if it actually wasn’t comedogenic. Silly me believed the label but there are comedogenic ingredients in the first five listed.... I broke out like crazy and I thought it was anything but this moisturizer.  So my breakout continued and I finally recovered after figuring out what it was.  It’s unfortunate because it is truly moisturizing and dry skin girls will love this!  My nose is a big time problem area for texture and this moisturizer kicked a punch for soothing the texture. If you don’t break out much or at all this would work great for you I’m sure.  But sensitive girls I would not buy this until you’ve tested it for at least a week. Don’t believe the noncomedogenic warning. Do your research on the ingredients.

review_text: I live in the desert, and my skin is incredibly dry and simultaneously acne-prone. It’s very frustrating, since many acne-targeting products tend to dry out the skin. This moisturizer seems to be the perfect balance as it’s incredibly rich and hydrating, but sinks into the skin quickly. For this reason it wears beautifully under makeup but also hydrates very well overnight. And not only has it not broken my skin out, but it’s reduced existing breakouts and given clarity and smoothness to my skin. I’ve been struggling with acne and my skin in general for about 12 years now, and this product is one of the first that I’ve loved so much I feel it can replace other steps in my routine. Rather than adding additional acids or serums as I normally do, I’ve reduced to just cleanser, toner and this moisturizer and have seen my skin clearing up and looking brighter. I would recommend this in a heartbeat!

review_text: This stuff is awesome! Out of countless creams, serums, and masks at every price point that I’ve tried over the years to get a handle on the blotchy redness on my face and upper chest, this is the only one that had [nearly immediate] results. Calming indeed! I have lupus with the characteristic “butterfly“ rash across my cheeks as well as a permanently flushed upper chest, and sun damage hyperpigmentation all over, too. It doesn’t seem to be curative (which I hadn’t expected), but it does prove to alleviate the redness for at least 8-10 hours. My skin tone is far more even, and my makeup looks fantastic now. It plays well with other skin care and makeup - No pilling or gross texture/residue, nor does it make makeup look cakey. It’s very hydrating and no scent. Absorbs nicely. I wish it came in a bigger jar because I use it twice a day, including on my neck and chest. It’s not obnoxiously expensive, which is great. Very happy to have finally found something that works - all the others I’d tried were nothing more than ridiculously over priced snake oils.

review_text: Docking one star because this comes with no seal on it and the last jar I got had dried product on the outside of the lid. Not being able to account for any kind of safety (and getting a new jar with dry crusty product on it) is awful. That said, I’ve used this moisturizer off and on for a while and it’s now a permanent part of my routine. I have sensitive (can’t use any silicones or most fragrance), blemish-prone, dehydrated combination skin. I focus my routine around hydration, anti-aging, and blemish prevention, and I’ve also been slowly trying to find places in my routine to cut both unnecessary steps and unnecessary cost. I have a lot of affordable serums/and cleansers I love, but I recently took a break from buying this and tried a less expensive moisturizer with fantastic ingredients. My skin looked duller. I wasn’t having reactive breakouts but I was getting occasional blemishes and texture. It wasn’t unheard of for me but it didn’t look great.I’ve been back on the Adaptogen moisturizer for a week and I just went to put on foundation for a zoom meeting and realized I didn’t need it. My skin is even and glowy, I don’t have a single blemish, and my dehydration lines are plumped out (I was marveling at my smooth forehead in the Zoom screen). I knew this product was good for my skin, but seeing the difference after not using it has sold me. The price is fair for how well it works and it’s an investment I’m happy to make- I just wish they’d put a safety seal for consumers on it.Texture-wise, this is a little thick but isn’t heavy or greasy. I usually mix it with a drop of oil at night and my skin is combo.

review_text: Somewhere in my 30’s I developed sensitivity and allergic reactions to most moisturizers and sunscreens and went without for many years.  I discovered YTTP last year and have been obsessed with their Superfood Air-Whip Moisture Cream ever since. I was sent this moisture cream to be used in combination with the Adaptogen Soothe   Hydrate Activated Mist with Reishi   Ashwagandha and asked for a review. After 2 weeks of use, I’m happy to report that they did not cause any sensitivity or allergic reactions. I did notice that the combination does have a slight woodsy nature smell to them despite being fragrance free. Overall, I’m happy with the product and my skin feels great but I don’t notice any difference in my skin using these products than when I was using my other YTTP cream. And now that I see that each product is to be purchased individually, that would most likely dissuade me from purchasing these both.

review_text: Tbh I expected sooo much more from this product. I have normal/oily skin & I was looking for an intensely moisturizing cream to use at night since my oiliness is due to living in the desert (hydration at night is key to help combat oiliness in the skin with dry environments!). After reading all the great reviews I was willing to invest the money since I was *expecting* it to be the holy grail of deeply moisturizing creams. And honestly it’s just OK, didn’t do anything special for my skin in terms of ‘deep’ moisture and I feel like I’ve used better deep moisturizers in the past (that cost a fraction of what this costs) that have given me noticeably better moisturization results. The cream has a light, almost clay-like consistency that I think other people might like, but it was not what I was expecting/looking for in terms of results. Gave it 3 starts because 1. It’s not terrible, 2. it didn’t smell bad, and 3. the ingredients are really good. All in all I would not buy this again.

review_text: Got this in a Sephora sampler bag. It’s VERY heavy, similar to Ponds Cold Cream, like someone else noted. And I didn’t use much, and concentrated on the under-eye area, where I need more hydration. It stayed on the surface of my oilier areas, like nose. Concerned that since I already am prone to blackheads, this might make them worse? I did enjoy the rose scent because it reminds me of my Grandma’s rosewater & glycerin hand lotion. Not everyone will like that aspect, I’m sure. This cream took a long time to absorb. And I didn’t see any effect different than lesser-priced alternatives. Thus far, I’ve bought 3 CT items and have NOT been impressed with any of them. Returned the full-size ones for refunds. Am disappointed that this brand, at least in my experience, is over-hyped and over-priced, unless you like paying for lux packaging vs. effective product!

review_text: Works beautifully as a face base, prior to applying makeup. Will have makeup looking great all day! As a moisturizer, it’s mediocre. It’s mostly oils. Although it contains, humectants, Antioxidants, and peptides, it’s in low doses. Makes skin LOOK hydrated, but doesn’t feel like it’s hydrating skin deep; appears to just sit on the surface. When I apply to my skin, it doesn’t dissolve until I rub it in, letting me to believe it just sits on top of the skin. Has a consistency like soft cold-pressed oil. Very little spreads effortlessly over the skin. Can work for most skin types; wouldn’t recommend for milia-prone skin though. No irritating scent. Again, great face base, but as a moisturizer, I notice no real benefits. For the cost, I personally won’t be purchasing in the future. But I would still recommend as a excellent face base for those who don’t mind the splurge.

review_text: Everyone raved about this cream as being the best primer so I had to buy it. But honestly, I’m not very impressed. I think if I had never used Bobbi Brown Face Base, I would probably love it. But since I have and they’re the same type of product (a heavy moisturizer cream to be used as a primer) I can’t help but feel the Face Base is worlds better. It smells better, has a better texture, feels more soothing. Do both of them hydrate? Yes. Do both of them create a good base for makeup? Yes. Are they to be created equal? No. Face Base is 3 dollars cheaper for nearly twice the product and I honestly think is twice as good. But this is a good cream. If you don’t like the scent of Face Base or you’re just really into beautiful packaging, you’ll most likely be happy with this. But if you’ve never tried either and you’re in the market for this type of product, go with the Face Base. It’s a holy grail item and has been on the best seller list for years for a reason.

review_text: Charlotte Tilbury’s Magic Cream was my go-to moisturizer for the longest time. I then went on to experiment with other brands. Getting this Magic Cream reminded me of how amazing this product truly is. My skin is very dehydrated. I’m talking dry like the Sahara Desert. When applying foundation, I can see the exaggerated dry spots. I no longer have that problem thanks to this moisturizer. The Magic Cream instantly plumps, brightens, and hydrates the skin. It also leaves a radiant glow. My foundation applies so smoothly over it, and it leaves my face looking flawless. Just be sure to let the moisturizer really sink in, because if you immediately try to apply your foundation over it, it could ball up and turn into a terrible mess. It has a thick texture, but it sinks in quickly, and it’s not sticky, greasy, or heavy feeling. I do want to point out that I’ve never experienced any clogging of the pores or acne while using this product. Also, for those that are sensitive to fragrances, please be aware that this is a scented product. However, I personally don’t find the scent to be too strong or overpowering. The upgraded glass jar packaging is very luxurious looking, and I love that you can buy a refill of the cream only, so you can reuse your jar. Beautiful skin and environmentally friendly? Yes please! This product is expensive. However, I do believe it’s worth it. One jar will last you a long time as you only need the smallest amount. I’m so happy to have this fabulous product back in my life. The Magic Cream truly is a magic cream.

review_text: I purchased this moisturizer along with three other products to combat fine lines and extremely dry, flakey skin I developed while pregnant. I never saw any significant results to be honest and so I switched to the Versed moisturizer after I was about 90% done with the product.  Since switching I’ve seen a MASSIVE difference in my skin, no more flaking, fine lines have faded, brighter complexion to name a few changes.  However I didn’t immediately place blame on the Magic Cream as I had introduced a lot of other products into my routine. I ran out of the Versed one and began using what I had leftover from the CT and this is what compelled me to write this review. With only 3 days of use, dry and flaking patches have returned all over my cheeks and forehead and a bumpy texture has developed on my cheeks. This is the only thing that has changed in my routine in the past 3 days. I am now convinced that this cream does less than nothing for $100. Save your money and your skin and invest elsewhere as I am sure now more than ever you are paying for packaging and certainly not a product that does anything is claims to - not even at a minimum does it moisturize

review_text: OK this stuff I love but hate at the same time. It pills all over if you try to apply your foundation with a brush, so I have to use a sponge to apply every single formula, whether it’s a stick foundation, or a liquid. So that sucks. Then when I do use a sponge it still pills along my jaw line so I take a large fluffy brush with nothing on it and I sweep away any pills. Why do I love it? I’m in my mid 40’s and my skin is dry as a desert and this is the only day cream I’ve ever tried that actually works. I even add 2 drops of Holy Grail Oil by Farmacy to make it even more hydrating. Then I follow with a light spf and after that there’s really no primer needed. I buy the half ounce pots because it’s cheaper than buying the full pot and if you buy 3 of the little ones you’re almost getting the full amount. I would recommend this to mature women only. If you have oily skin or you still get acne I wouldn’t buy it.

review_text: I received this moisturizer from Influenster complimentary in exchange for my honest review of the product. So here goes…I hated this moisturizer! It made my face feel absolutely disgusting. I had such high hopes for it bc obvs Charlotte Tilbury is such a high end skincare brand, but I was disappointed. The rose scent is so noxious and overpowering. It’s way too strong for a skincare product IMO. The cream is thick and has a nice consistency until I started working it into my skin. Then it turns into a slippery and greasy disaster. My pores immediately felt clogged and it felt so heavy on my skin. It never fully penetrated and just sat on the surface all night. The next morning I washed my face immediately upon waking and to my surprise…it broke me out! I am 39 and have never had acne or issues with breakouts of any kind. One night using this moisturizer and I was broke out on both cheeks, my chin; the crease and tip of my nose and along my jawline. Save your money and buy something else bc this ain’t it folks. The only reason I’m giving it 2 stars instead of 1 is for the heavy, beautiful jar/packaging and the massage technique to apply it.

review_text: I have gone through 3 1.7oz jars, 4 0.5oz minis, and 1.5 5.1oz mega-jars (currently working on a mega-jar). Suffice to say, I have a lot of experience with this product. I adore it. I bought my first jar at Barneys in NYC (the only place I could find the brand at the time) in 2014. Admittedly, I bought it to be fancy. But it turned out that my skin and I just love it. It’s very nourishing. And depending on whether you apply just a bit or a heavier layer, it works well as a pre-makeup moisturizer or a night cream. It’s gentle, effective, and in my opinion very much worth it. While I have been interested in other moisturizers, I never stray from this one. It’s always in my arsenal. And if ever my skin is angry, this is always a safe bet. It is lightly fragranced, but it just smells like moisturizer to me. Idk. I just really love it and highly recommend it. All of my friends have received a jar as a gift and all feel similarly.

review_text: I got this as a sample size in a value pack - I was really after the copper peptide serum, but for the price I didn’t mind trying out some extras! Given the regular price of this moisturizer I didn’t want to like it, but omg i’m in love and will have to repurchase! I don’t know if it’ll work so well in the summer months, it may be too heavy, but for winter it’s a-m-a-z-i-n-g! It somehow feels perfectly light, rich, and nourishing at the same time. A little goes a long way. My skin is just so plump and balanced after using this! It doesn’t leave me looking or feeling greasy or shiny at all. It actually almost makes my skin look matte, but without any of the dullness or dryness.I don’t remember now if there was any fragrance in the ingredients list, but I don’t notice a scent one way or the other. I am very used to fragrance-free products though/prefer that, so if you’re used to sweet-smelling skincare, you may not like it. I haven’t experience any irritation or breakouts from this at all.

review_text: I’m so impressed with this facial cream!I’m one week in to use during colder weather in SoCal. My face was getting chapped and looking dry and dull, too. I tried The Ordinary rose oil and that was a little better but i couldn’t wear it during the day and it wasn’t helping with the dryness as much as i would have liked. Enter Biossance! Best of all, my skin is soft and moisturized! Will it work in the summer? I don’t know but im willing to try it out considering how quickly this delivered results. I knocked off a star for price point. Seems steep for under 2 oz., but take into consideration i compared this against La Mer and i think this worked WAY better. I’m def gonna buy the full sized product.

review_text: I’m so in love with this moisturizer! I’m so picky about moisturizers because my skin is so weird. I’m 36, have combination skin leaning more to the dry side, get a few break outs and flare ups that last forever on my chin and forehead and use prescription retinol that drys my out a bit more. I’ve only used this in the winter so far but I think it’ll be my all year nightly moisturizer. I was going through an especially hard time with my skin when I started this. I had upped my retinol a bit causing dryness and wearing face masks has been causing extra chin and jaw breakouts. I started using this at night as my last step in my skin care routine and it has totally healed and hydrated my skin after just a few days. My skin feels smoother, more hydrated, plumper and my breakouts are disappearing (not for this but from finding a moisturizer that works with my acne medication). I’m so happy I finally tried this! I noticed the very very faintest smell when first applying but people in the reviews are being extremely DRAMATIC about the scent. I’m really sensitive to scents and this has almost no scent to it. There is the faintest lightest scent that is from the actual active ingredients of the product that are helping your skin. The thing is Biossance didn’t add any harsh fragrances or chemicals that are terrible for your skin to try to entice you into trying the product...we should all prefer this to smelling like vanilla while damaging our skin. Thank you Biossance for always using safe, effective, cruelty free and sustainable ingredients only!

review_text: I LOVE this moisturizer. It saved my skin! I had to start using a prescription retinoid for my adult acne (I’m 27) and it really dried out my skin. I started using this morning and night and my skin barrier is back to normal! No more flaking! And no breakouts! The only issue is the packaging. I’ve seen others comment that after a while it starts to smell. I have found this too. It wasn’t enough to notice, but when I opened a new bottle I noticed that it smelled much nicer than my old one. I think it is because as time passes, dipping your fingers into the bottle deposits bacteria and those accumulate in the product. I solved this by tranfering the cream into a pump bottle that I bought of amazon (kind of looks like the drunk elephant protini bottle). It’s kind of a hassle, but the product is so good I don’t mind. I hope they switch to more hygenic packaging in the future!

review_text: Since my skin is combo, acne-prone, and sensitive, I usually steer clear of using any creams that seem heavy/rich.BUT, since I’d never tried a Biossance product that clogged my pores or broke me out, I decided to get a sample anyways and give it a go.WOW is this product an exception to that!!When you first feel this cream, it will seem thick, but when you smooth it onto your skin, (little goes a long way) it absorbs so quickly and doesn’t feel like you have this layer on your skin. It’s also calming and makes my skin instantly feel comfortable (even when it’s angry at me). NEVER broke me out or clogged pores and had no problems using it over existing blemishes (which is rare). It balances out my oily and dry areas and repairs my moisture barrier faster than any of the dozens of products I’ve tried (from cheap to very expensive).

review_text: I recently was given this product to try and to review. I’ve used it about five times thus far and do notice more moisture in my skin. I tend to have dry skin and my makeup absorbs right away if I dont use a moisturizer prior to application. I tried upside this prior to makeup application and loved the result. My makeup looked smooth and near flawless. I’ve also used it before bed and let it work it’s magic without makeup on. The formula has a nice, smooth consistency and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and soft. I’m not a huge fan of the smell, it’s not bad, but also not good. I would say it’s a medicated lotion smell, it’s a little off putting but it’s not a deal breaker. A little bit of this goes a long way. Definitely recommend for people who have dry/red skin. I definitely feel much more life in my face when using this product and for days after if I miss a couple days. I Highly recommend it.

review_text: Wow! This is such an amazing luxurious moisturizer. It honestly goes on like buttery velvet and sinks in quickly leaving skin soft smooth and hydrating without greasiness. I do 4 dots one on the forehead two on the cheeks and one on the chin and rub it all in so that it’s even. I was worried when I used this because I have very acne prone skin and my skin breaks out often when I try new moisturizers but I’ve used this over 2 weeks and I have no new acne! So is say if you’re nervous about using a thicker cream I’d say this one is a safe one for us acne babes! I was nervous because of the “Shea butter” ingredient but just trust me this is the good good. Also it will probably last you your entire mortal life you need so little. So the price actually is justified for me. If you’re on the fence this is me telling you through the screen this is the beat moisturizer I’ve ever used and a good moisturizer makes a big difference to your moisturizer skin barrier. And I use a lot of exfoliating products I need to protect it well.

review_text: So, also a part of my coveted, complimentary #springpicksvoxbox was an offering from @biossance : its Squalane + Omega Repair Cream. Now, I’ve got to say that I’ve never come across a Biossance product I didn’t adore before; truly, they usually work very well for me! So, I’m really sorry to say that I had some degree of difficulty even using this product. Outwardly, it looks promising: nice packaging, definitely a “creamy-cream,” and it’s from Biossance. That alone would likely get me to buy it if I were out at Sephora and in the market for a new cream. But if I did, I’d be disappointed. For me, I couldn’t get past the smell. Now, it’s advertised as unscented but I got a strong, almost-nostalgic smell of chlorine-mold-mildew-y pool deck at the local Water Park, and I think we all know what the kiddos do in the public pool at their discretion. I don’t know if it’s the squalane or what, but the smell is so off-putting it’s borderline offensive to the olfactory receptors. review_text: I received this product from influenster for my honest review, and I was so excited to get started! I did not want to write a review at the beginning of my journey, so I waited and it’s been close to a month. I have used this moisturizer after washing my face with a age renewal cream cleanser, toning, and applying a serum not products of biossance. I have had very dry skin with some adult acne on my cheeks occasionally. I have to say the cream moisturizer feels really good on application, it does not have a strong scent, and it seeps in pretty deep into the top layers of my skin. I would occasionally reapply overnight as my skin would get a little dry. I live in a desert and southern California and it’s very cold and dry this time of year. I did not see a great change in fine lines, but the dryness was definitely better as a result. I am going to be 40 and I’m definitely having some hormonal changes that has been affecting my skin, so I will continue to use to see what results I have.

It absorbs fairly quickly when you rub into the skin, but does leave a slight film. I think this is great for normal skin. It has a really rich texture almost like a hybrid between a balm and moisturizer. Jars are not my favorite since you have to dip in and sanitary reasons, but I think it is the right component as it might be too thick for a pump. Overall I love this moisturizer, but think if you have dry skin you might not like the satin finish and want a dewier one

review_text: I started off with a trial size of this and realized I loved it. I will continue to purchase this and the whole Biossance line, it has done AMAZING things for my skin and I get compliments about my “glow” all the time.

review_text: I’m now 35 and have combination skin, one dark spot and the tiniest faintest wrinkles starting to form; also the occasional bout/cluster of acne. As a proponent of the less is more movement in skincare, I am a huge fan of Kiehl’s and the Ordinary line of products (I have their entire arsenal). I was initially skeptical about whether this product would be worth the price tag, but after the first use I was hooked. I use this once or twice a week and it’s such a treat. It has a sweet honey-like smell, goes on smooth and creamy but not at all thick. If you’ve just exfoliated your skin (and be careful not to be too aggressive), you might feel the AHAs in this product working with the slight tingling/stinging. However, that dissipates quickly and I then wake up the next morning to baby-soft moisturized skin that looks bright and refreshed.I really can not recommend Honeymoon Glow  enough. I’ll be buying this aptly-named product over and over again as long as the formulation stays the same!

review_text: I used this product for about six months and really liked the results. It’s hydrating while keeping oil production in check. I recently had a cystic acne flare do to medication changes and decided to stop using all my usual products to simplify my routine. After about three weeks of only using mild cleanser and prescribed topical treatment, I noticed I had horrible blackheads piling up on my nose. I tried everything to get rid of them and nothing worked. I added this serum back into my routine after consulting with my dermatologist and the blackheads were completely gone within a week. I don’t think it is doing much to control my acne, but it is well worth the price just for the blackhead control.

review_text: Over the past year I have purchased and tried so many new skincare products from Sephora. I am 40 now and find myself enjoying and experiencing new products to prevent or address my many skincare concerns. I added acids (found lactic to best suit my needs) to my routine after discovering SR Good Genes, which is amazing yet very pricey. I decided to give Farmacy Honeymoon Glow a chance as their line is clean and very affordable (relatively speaking to some of the other options out there). I was blown away after the first night I used. Woke up to very supple and moisturized skin. My skin also appeared brighter and very clear. Although Honeymoon Glow tingles, there is absolutely no irritation to the skin, and I have extremely sensitive skin with eczema and dermatitis if not careful with my products. I rotate this product in with my other pricier lactic acid skin care options. Will continue to use and enjoy, thank you Farmacy!! I highly recommend!

For reference I have dry skin and suck at washing my face. If a product can make this much a difference for me with little effort, it feels worth the price. I also use Farmacy cleansing balm and Wishful honey balm. It seems to be a good combo of products. I would say the biggest thing to know is this product is strong, for me it’s more like a peel than a serum. I’ll use it again next week when my skin barriers back to normal. Definitely like the results. Four stars just because it’s freakishly expensive.

I put this on at night, and wake up with glowing skin. (I’m 42, my skin is slowly drying out, so glowing is a major fete!) Highly recommend Honeymoon Glow!

review_text: This is the first chemical exfoliant I’ve ever tried. I didn’t really notice any changes at all for the first week, so I kind of wondered if I had wasted my money on an expensive product that had no results. I was very wrong!! When used consistently every other day or every 2 days, this makes your skin sooo smooth and soft and clear. My skin hasn’t felt this soft since elementary school. Honestly, my pores don’t look smaller or anything, but my skin has been really dry and crackly this year to the point that it felt rough and flaky a lot of the time... even when I was using a manual/physical exfoliant!! With this, my skin feels like silk?? Velvet? Just like something extremely soft. It also seems to have cleared up some small under the skin bumps on my forehead. Although it’s really great, I’m not sure if I’d recommend this for the price it’s at... I’ll have to try some cheaper alternatives once I run out of this to see if I can get similar results. We’ll see. I’ll definitely repurchase if I can’t find anything comparable. As for negatives..... it doesn’t smell great, and it will slightly burn or tingle for the first few seconds after you put it on. My least favorite thing about it is the smell, but it’s worth putting up with for the results. I still rate it 5 stars because I prefer my products to not have a masking fragrance anyway, and so far my skin is looking amazing.

review_text: This product has become my new ‘go-to’. I was experiencing a small breakout and this product cleared it up almost over night! Within a few days my skin was completely clear. I have very dry and sensitive skin so I was skeptical to incorporate this AHA into my routine. The thought of using an acid on my face left me hesitant. But I’m sure glad I did my research and got over my fear. My skin is glowing now. For anyone questioning whether or not to try this, you definitely should! If any of you are wondering what AHAs are, it’s Alpha Hydroxy Acid, which is actually recommended for people with sensitive skin. It helps with acne, brighten skin, and helps reduce redness amongst many other things. BHA’s, while having their many amazing benefits, are a little more harsh because they cleanse deeper into the pore, and are more-so for people with oily to combination skin. Anyways, you’ve got to do your research and see what works for you, but as for me, I love this product — it rocks!

I ditched everything else in my night routine and now after washing my face ​I apply this followed by the Youth To The People Superberry Hydrate overnight mask. That is all I do and my skin is definitley​ looking better and more clear than when I was using 4-5 products in my routine. This has even cleared up some stubborn hormonal acne I have. Super impressed and will definitley​ be repurchasing.

review_text: I didn’t like it at first. But a month after doing research on how to properly use these types of serums, I decided to give it another try in attempt to not waste it. Turns out it works better than I expected, I just made the mistake of applying it directly without a proper moisturizer was apparently too harsh on my skin. I changed my night skin care routine 2-3 nights a week to include the honeymoon glow: I start with washing my face, then a hydrating water gel, then a lightweight moisturizer (I just use cetaphil for this part), allow to dry, then I apply the farmacy serum. My face looks dewy, moisturized, and soft the next morning. I have less blackheads on my nose (my skin purged a bit and had skin peeling around my nose in the first couple times after restarting it but I kept using it and my skin looks good!)

review_text: I purchased the Honeymoon Glow because my wallet can not afford a the Drunk Elephant $90 serum right now and also the ingredients were impressive. Especially since it has no silicones. I had purchased the mini Drunk Elephant TLC three times and saw no difference as I still had congestion on my forehead and chin. I had been using the TLC everyday and knew my skin was strong enough to tolerate a higher blend of acids. The results of the Honeymoon Glow have been impeccable. All of my congestion has been cleared, my complexion appears clearer and a lot of the redness I had, has faded. My skin is so impervious that it needs something as strong as a 14% to be changed. I have now started using the serum every day except for Sunday’s, my chemical peel days. The texture of my skin has improved dramatically, adding to the positive’s of the serum.  Overall, I love the Farmacy Honeymoon Glow! It’s a wonderful, luxurious serum that delivers, and for the price point, it’s even better.

review_text: I’m using a combination of other anti aging products, so it’s not clear exactly if this product specifically is the reason my skin feels soft, hydrated and smooth. But I’ve had no issues using this product and I’m almost done the bottle. I did not have any redness or irritation, but I also have normal skin type. I started off using it twice a week as instructed by a Sephora employee. Then slowly to every night as tolerated and have had no issues. Ever since I started using it, I’ve noticed I’m getting significantly less breakouts and my skin doesn’t get oily during the day anymore. I used to break out easily but now I’ve fully developed normal skin for the first time in my life! I’m in my late 20s for reference. The scent is not strong so I was surprised when I saw some reviews saying the smell is horrible. It also has a “clean green” stamp which is very important to me. Perhaps it has that scent some people seem to hate because they do not add synthetic fragrances? Anyway, 5 stars for me! Will purchase again.

I find if I get a pimple this will zap it very quickly and it makes my skin texture as smooth as silk. Reducing lines, pores and acne scars in one day, use it for a few weeks and your skin is going to shock you with how amazing it will look! Seriously, I just love this stuff (I have 3 backups, lol)!

review_text: This pricey bottle is worth every penny! I was using the Youth To The People AHA kombucha toner before I changed it to this and I am SO GLAD I did. YTP toner would leave my skin feeling uncomfortably sticky. This serum burns at first, and if you’re not used to AHA serums it could be considered painful because the sting is powerful. But after the first time it just gets easier and easier until your skin builds up tolerance and you don’t even feel anything. Before I apply this serum, I tone with a rosewater toner, I apply the Ordinary Hyluronic serum. when I finally apply this serum my skin absorbs it and it feels firm and soft. i layer it on top with rose Fresh moisturizer and I wake up in the morning with my skin feeling perfect; the blemishes from the night before almost non existent. review_text: I had been using the Ole Henriksen Invigorating Night serum and it had been doing an ok job, but I felt that my skincare routine needed a boost. So I talked to the Sephora skincare expert and they recommended the Honeymoon Glow to me. And boy, am I grateful! The consistency of the Honeymoon Glow works perfectly with all my other skincare. Whereas the Invigorating Night serums gel consistency did not blend well with my other skincare items. Also, the mix of AHA’s and BHA’s get not just the surface of my skin, but down into the pores, unlike the Invigorating Night serum which just affects the surface of the skin. I also think that you end up using less of the Honeymoon Glow, because it’s cream formula spreads easier and doesn’t dry down as quick. Nor does it dry down to a tacky finish like the Invigorating Night serum does. All in all it’s a stellar find that I’m happy to have been directed to.

review_text: Everyone’s skin is different and that needs to be understood when reading these reviews. I was far more swayed by the amount of good reviews on this product, so i purchased. I have fair skin, blonde hair, blue eyes, and for further context, I tan a bit in the summer but still susceptible to burning (like most whiteppl). Ive only used demonologist grade products for the past few years, but ran out of some products so I decided to see what was hot at Sephora. Got this and used it for about 2.5 weeks, broke out quite a bit, and I don’t break out much at all anymore so yes this was quite unusual. Some of you may say it’s a “purge“ period, however, if anyone of you have used medical grade products you’ll know that there’s no purge period with demonologist grade products lol. There’s purge periods with peels and facials, but the products don’t do that typically. Anyways, I don’t doubt this has worked wonders on people’s skin, however, don’t go in with the expectation that it will do the same for you. Always be skeptical of skincare, stop using when you notice problems and move on to the next option. PS. when using any products like this one, ALWAYS wear sunscreen. Without SPF, any exfoliation/resurfacing serum will be doing serious damage to your skin, even if they’re “working“ for you. These products are harsh, whether they work or don’t work for you, they still are. They will always make your skin drastically more susceptible to sun damage if you don’t wear SPF while using them, and that damage will become visible sooner than later.
review_title: As always, it depends on your skin type

review_text: first off, this product has a strong fragrance and while that’s not necessarily a deal breaker for me, i prefer products that dont have one at all and thought that point would be helpful for some of you to be aware of. next, I wanted to love this. I was prepared to become a fan of all things tatcha. but the truth is, after doing a ton of research, the price point cannot be justified and it’s just overall an ok product but definitely not worth the money. there are tons of products out there to try so dont settle on this one. yes it felt great going on despite a slightly tacky residue it left behind but the moisturized feeling didn’t last nearly as long as several other moisturizers I’ve tried, such as the Lotus night cream, for instance. or Kiehls ultra. also, I don’t have sensitive skin but this caused my skin to fuss a bit- there was definitely an adjustment period that’s for sure. the other major detractor for me was how heavy this felt and how greasy it made me look and feel for hours on end. yuck. definitely does NOT play nice under makeup. made everything slide around and also seemed to interact with some of my products causing further irritation and the need to adjust my routine to accommodate it. ugh. more trouble than it’s worth in more ways than one. so your research on this product and the tatcha line in general to decide if its money you think will be well spent for you or not, dont just fall into the hype because this could very well be an expensive mistake.

Hopefully I can repair the damage it’s done to my skin soon…

review_text: I have dry, sensitive skin.  I was very surprised to see that when I used this product my face became very itchy and red. I wasn’t expecting this reaction from such a “pure“ and quite expensive product.  This product does offer A LOT of moisture, which is great for my dry skin, however the redness and itchiness is not ideal.  It does have a fragrance. Unfortunately, I would recommend this product for people with combination skin and those with no sensitivities.  I am interested in buy more Tatcha products, but am afraid I might have another adverse reaction.

review_text: So far, so great!  I have only been using this for 2 days now, but already have some strong opinions on this one.  My skin feels so moisturized and smooth!  Very hydrating.  I would absolutely not recommend you use this under makeup, however.  This is strictly a nighttime routine type of product.  Because it is so moisturizing, it can feel a bit greasy, and if you apply a lot, it can pill.  Neither of which are any issue when you’re sleeping in it, but would absolutely sabotage any makeup look you put over it.  Stick to nighttime with this one.  Again, amazing product that truly makes my skin feel drenched in heavy duty moisturizing power, and as a side note, the packaging is truly beautiful and functional with the built-in spatula for applying the product.  Not only is the little spatula infinitely more sanitary, but, unlike so many other products that come with a spatula that inevitably gets lost, this one slides directly into the lid for secure storage, making it much less likely to be lost.  This is a well thought out product that I am immediately impressed with!

review_text: I see a lot of people saying this gives them acne breakouts.  Maybe cause they use too much, too often or it’s something else? Idk. But I have combination (more oily) skin & somehow this doesn’t ever make me breakout. I use a very small amount all over my face & neck 3-4 times a week. Only at night. I let it sink in for at least an hour before sleeping because it’s so dewy. The rest of the week I use Tatcha Water Cream because it’s lighter. Personally I absolutely love this product. A little goes a long way & surprisingly it doesn’t have an overpowering smell that triggers my very sensitive scent allergies. I’m in my 30’s now & have been using anti aging skincare since I was in my early teens - premature aging isn’t something I’ve ever wanted. They say the skin gets drier & duller as we age (which is why I added this to my nighttime routine) & it’s been doing pretty well now for almost a year - in terms of keeping my skin moisturized. Dryness isn’t an issue for me, but dullness can be if I slack for a few days (covid lazy lul). Anyway, I highly recommend at least trying this out. The price tag is high, but I believe the shelf life is 12mo (?) so really it’s not expensive once a year if you think about it.

More youthfulness, glow, less acne and flare-ups, smaller pores. It looks like I had a hydrafacial for the past 2 weeks straight. At first I was nervous to use because of the purple/synthetic appearance, but switching to other lotions makes my skin mad. This purple goodness is what my skin craves and needs. PS - I definitely recommend the essence with it as well.

review_text: As someone who loves Tatcha products, I was a little nervous to try this product out since it’s said to be for people with dry skin. However, I read from another review that it works wonders for oily complexions when used as a night cream. After using this a couple of times, I have to say that I really like it. It is a bit thick, which I guess is to be expected since it is for dry skin, but once it has settled, it really does make my skin look healthy and glowing. What I also love is how, just like with most (if not all) of Tatcha’s products is that you really don’t need to use a ton to get enough “coverage,“ if that makes sense? As someone with a big ol’ head, I tend to go overboard with the amount of skincare I apply to my face, but a little scoop from the golden spatula is enough to cover my entire face. I do use extra for my neck, of course, and it works nicely for that too. I also love the clean, fresh, citrus scent of this cream. As silly as this sounds, it helps me feel so relaxed and calm. Overall, I would definitely recommend it to those who want to pamper themselves. Just make sure to not go and use a whole glob every time you want to apply it. It will feel thick at first, but that feeling goes away after a little bit.

review_text: I have combination skin. I’m closing into my 30’s, so I noticed my skin is changing as well. Although, my skin does lean onto the oiler side. This product woks for my skin. I have sensitive skin. My skin is acne prone, itchy and really red. I only need a little bit of this product to soothe the redness and stop the itching. My skin feels soft and plump. However, if I use too much, I will break out because my skin already has enough oil (anything of too much can be bad at times). So, I only need dime size and it works. Fortunately, this product will last me two months because of how little I need to use it on a daily bases. In the past, I have used so many moisturizers from drug store to high end brands and they all had terrible effects on me. Some caused severe break outs, others made my skin itch and caused uneven texture (the little red bumps) or left an ugly residue on my face. Other times the smell of the products would give me headaches. I tried tons and all left me feeling miserable about my skin. I keep coming back to this product. It’s beautifully packaged. The texture of the creme is lovely. It blends well with other products such as face washes ( biossance, first aid beauty) and makeup. I will be looking into other Tatcha products. It’s pricey but it last in my case it last quite a while.

review_text: I LOVE Tatcha products so I was excited to try this. It is meant as a day cream to be put on before your makeup—it was designed in conjunction with a celebrity makeup artist. I have very dry, dehydrated, mature skin and love the Dewy Skin Mist and face mask so I was very excited to try this and eventually get the Dewy Night Cream for night. review_text: When I first purchased this product I was very excited but I was also nervous about it being worth the price. I have tried more expensive moisturizers and skin creams and am trying this after finishing my drunk elephant moisturizer. I have normal to dry skin and after seeing the claims of this product I concluded that this would be great and what I was looking for. After the initial application, I noticed that my skin felt hydrated and looked radiant. After about three weeks of use, I can say that it improved the plumpiness of my skin as well as the firmness. I didn’t have any texture prior to using this so I can’t measure its the effect on that. Overall I think this is a great product and would recommend to anyone with my skin type. Also for anyone wondering this formula is a lot different than the protini peptide moisturizer from drunk elephant but nevertheless I enjoy both formulas.

review_text: As someone who has really dry skin, I still prefer to wear the Belif moisture bomb at night (I think it’s the most hydrating moisturizer Sephora offers). But for wearing under makeup, Tatcha’s dewy skin cream is about the best you’re going to do. It’s like a moisturizer and primer in one. I was actually PRAYING I wouldn’t like this when I got a sample size to try, because after all it IS pricey. But sadly it IS worth the money... at least the mini size. I say that because I only plan on using this under makeup when I want to look my best. So I can justify spending the $20 on that (even though it’s still pricey for how little you get). But I already have been using Tatcha’s tinted eye cream for over a year, so I HAD to try this too and I’m glad I did! Also, I’ve tried their water cream and while it’s not good for dry skin most of the year, it works really well under makeup on a super hot day!! So yeah, Tatcha is worth the hype.

It’s amazing for dry skin as it’s super hydrating and definitely very dewy. I like using it at night as a good occlusive over skin care products but it also works well under more natural/matte fuller coverage foundations. You can really feel the silicone and the fragrance is definitely strong which is why I didn’t love it initially but neither have bothered my skin. I do feel like my skin looks nice and hydrated and plump in the morning which I don’t feel I get from many other moisturizers. Definitely going to repurchase with the next sale.

review_text: When first applying, my skin just drinks this in. I use as instructed. I only use a Pearl sized amount and apply it like a foundation. That tiny amount provides maximum moisture. review_text: I’ve been using this moisturizer for two months now and I’ve noticed the improvements to my skin recently. I use this moisturizer after the Tatcha rice wash cleanser but only have been using these at night. it doesn’t feel like it sits on top of my skin and it’s very breathable. I’ve noticed my skin is smoother now and it feels more elastic in a way, like it feels fuller when I touch my face (I guess that’s the plumping part of the name). I justified the price point of this product as a “treat myself” purchase, sometimes just having something with the label “luxury” helps with actually using the products and having a better routine for myself, but in the end I feel it’s very much worth the price. For as little as I use each night, I imagine this will last me a long time and it seems to have really turned my skin around.

full_text: If you want to treat yourself, this is it!. I’ve been using this moisturizer for two months now and I’ve noticed the improvements to my skin recently. I use this moisturizer after the Tatcha rice wash cleanser but only have been using these at night. it doesn’t feel like it sits on top of my skin and it’s very breathable. I’ve noticed my skin is smoother now and it feels more elastic in a way, like it feels fuller when I touch my face (I guess that’s the plumping part of the name). I justified the price point of this product as a “treat myself” purchase, sometimes just having something with the label “luxury” helps with actually using the products and having a better routine for myself, but in the end I feel it’s very much worth the price. For as little as I use each night, I imagine this will last me a long time and it seems to have really turned my skin around.

review_text: Love it!!! Over the summer the tatcha water cream became my go to.  I switched up to the dewy skin cream for the winter and love it!  It has a rich long lasting consistency (which we need when it’s 20 degrees outside), but doesn’t leave me with that oily feeling midday like most other skin creams.  This cream is excellent for holding that moisturized (dewy) look.  I use the dewy cream underneath the tatcha pore refining SPF.  Sometimes I add a little highlight on top and go foundation less or I can throw on a little primer and add a few drops of foundation on top as well.  I love makeup, but use a dime size amount of foundation.  Not sure how this would work underneath a heavy application of makeup.

This cream is perfect to soothe and moisturize at night and I wake up with glowy, plump skin. It’s a bit heavy for daytime wear for me personally, but I do use it during the day at times when my skin is feeling especially sensitive. The whole process of using the cream is truly an experience. It feels so silky and luxurious as you apply it and smells amazing. Plus the color and the jar are truly beautiful!

review_text: Tatcha’s Dewy Skin Cream contains healthy nutrients like Japanese Purple Rice, Okinawa Algae Blend, and Hyaluronic Acid– all of which combine to attract water and help replenish the skin’s moisture barrier while plumping it. I lived on Okinawa for 10 years. Raised my children there. We all had a wonderful skin, bathing in the East China Sea, eating the food of the earth. We all stopped aging for 10 full years. review_text: Dewy Skin Cream is successful in creating a dewy complexion, but calling it a “cream“ feels almost misleading. It has the thickness of a cream, the weight of a balm, and the drag of a heavy, dry gel. My immediate thought was aerated (non-)petroleum jelly—it has its uses, but isn’t something I necessarily want on my face. While I can’t definitively identify the cream as the cause, I have experienced a mild breakout along the jaw and a looming, mid-face pimple (from someone who may get 2–3 per year, at best). I planned to use this product in the morning to take advantage of its cosmetic effects (and preferring something more “technical“ for sleep), but I have little desire wear it in any mix of heat or humidity, especially with sunscreen layered on. If used at night product, I’d suggest a generous time allowance for absorption before potentially touching face to pillow. I’ll try mixing sparingly with my preferred creams to make the texture palatable and maintain some of the effect, but Dewy Skin Cream is off the repurchase list. Beautifully packaged, unnecessarily fragranced.

Like I said, I can move on now, it’s done it’s job but it’s just too heavy to continue to use now.

review_text: I have normal to oily skin but wanted this mainly as a night cream. The more hydration as I sleep the better and I find the next day I produce less oil because my skin is balanced. review_text: I bought this wanting to love it because I love Tatcha! I have combo skin (oily t-zone and dry cheeks) and I read so many reviews stating this helped balance out their skin. I was excited to open it up and slather that pretty purple cream on my face, but that is the only good thing I have to say about it unfortunately. This just sat on my face and never really soaked in. I went to bed looking great and woke up feeling even greasier! I wanted this to work so I continued to use it and used less and less every night to the point where I was hardly using any, I still woke up looking like a grease ball every morning. After 5 days of use I started to get huge pimples on my checks and I looked greasy all day by the end of the week. I gave up and returned it and it took my skin a couple weeks to recover and return to normal.

review_text: I WANTED TO LOVE THIS SO BAD YALL!! I’m a Tatcha fanatic and use a good amount of her line in my everyday routine. Just to list them out: Cleansing Oil, Rice Polish, Essence, Water Cream, Pearl Eye Treatment, Firming Eye Serum, Brightening Serum, Silken Pore SPF, Silk Canvas Primer and Neck Cream. All that being said.. I have a pretty good understanding of the quality of Tatcha’s products are DEFINITELY worth the hype/splurge (scouts honor). Let me start off by saying I have Combo skin and to clarify.. I have oily t-zone, acne prone & my cheeks and nose are dry patch city if I use the wrong moisturizer. I used the Dewy Skin for a month and a half as my night time moisturizer before I realized we had to part ways *Sad Face*. Let me essplain... The first night after using the Dewy skin I immediately fell in love like all my other Tatcha skincare! My skin felt hydrated, refreshed and had a nice luminosity  but not greasy! So the next night was when it started going downhill... I woke up the next morning and saw these small skin colored bumps between the apples of my cheeks and my nostrils. Throughout the day.. the bumps would go away so I didn’t pay too much mind to it. Next day same bumps appeared in the same area AND on my forehead. But this time the we’re also a larger bumped joined in on the party. After switching back to my Water Cream as my morning and night time moisturizer.. I realized me and the Dewy skin couldn’t be pals anymore. All the bumps I experienced I’m suspecting they weren’t pimples but like temporarily/minorly clogged pores..?? Only because when I get a pimple/zip.. they stay for a really long time and then they leave a ridiculous scar forever! But the bumps would appear in the morning and sometime during the day! SO WEIRD!

review_text: I have loved all the Tatcha products I have tried and I have tried a lot. I bought this moisturizer for myself to keep my skin hydrated in the winter. I used it regularly for 4 weeks, it smelt amazing and really did a good job at hydrating my skin. I then started to get severe cystic acne on my skin, it was the most painful acne I have ever had. At 29 years old I was beyond embarrassed of my skin since I had worked so hard to maintain clear skin! I immediately stopped using it and my skin started to clear up, however, Tatcha’s customer service was literally amazing!! Which is why I am giving the product 3 stars. I was able to return the product and exchange it for the water crem which was 100% better for my skin type. I still love Tatcha, this product was just not made for acne prone skin!

review_text: This is a great moisturizer.  Its description says normal to dry skin, but this can even be used on oily skins like myself.  I normally use the water cream, but I really wanted to try this to be extra nourishing to my skin which is acne prone.  While my skin is very oily, it still needs to be moisturized so it won’t overproduce oil.  Anyways, this is a beautiful moisturizer.  It takes a good five to ten minutes to sink into the skin, while the water cream is almost instantly sunk in.  This also leaves a beautifully radiant skin like it claims, without looking oily like my face can be.  Its definitely dewy looking in a good way and looks its best either without makeup or under any foundation that is not matte.  You can use this with matte foundation with this to be extra nourishing, but you will not see the dewy look the way you would with other foundations. This does not trigger my acne and is not too heavy.  However, less is definitely more with this moisturizer.  You hardly need any to moisturize your entire face.  I use about half the amount of this compared to water cream (like 1-2 grains of rice literally).  From least hydrating to most hydrating from Tatcha is: Water Cream, Dewy Cream, Indigo Cream, Silk Cream, Luminous Dewy Cream. Comparing this to the dewy mist, this cream sinks into the skin much better and leaves a much more natural, long lasting, dominate raidiant dewy skin look.  I’m very happy with this purchase and if you have dry skin, you can save yourself quiet a bit of money by purchasing this instead of the silk cream.  (the indigo is barely more heavy than the dewy cream, but is specifically designed for those with sensitive skins and does not have a dewy skin look).  I also think this is a must-try if you really strive for “no-makeup“ makeup looks.  This is the best way to give you that naturally glowing, healthy skin look.

I had terrible breakouts for a little less than a year. During that time I changed my skin care routine completely, and switched out my FAB ultra repair cream for this, thinking it would help keep my skin barrier in tact while I used salicylic acid to get my acne under control. And it worked. My skin has been clear for about a month now. So I thought, let’s just try and use my FAB cream instead, and I kid you not, I had to get out of bed and wash my face after an hour. My skin was itchy and red, so irritated. I washed, put this on and my skin said AAAAHH...thank you. So crazy. I guess I’ll never try and leave you ever again.

review_text: I’ve been using this for about two months now and I’ve had fantastic results. I typically have very dry flaky skin but recently I started using a topical retinoid that has made my skin even more dry and dehydrated. I got the mini size to try out and instantly loved it. It is very rich and heavy but dries down and doesn’t feel greasy at all. It has been amazing for my irritated skin barrier- no other product that I’ve tried in the past has even come close to this. It is now a staple in my nightly skincare routine and a must-have for anyone who has dry, dehydrated skin or a messed up skin barrier. I don’t usually use it in the mornings as it doesn’t work well with my sunscreen. My only complaint is that the pump dispenses MUCH more than you need-- if you apply the whole pump, the cream pills- especially if you have additional skincare steps after this one. You really don’t need that much of it. I use a hydrating mist (Cicapair or thermal spring water) before putting this on which I find also makes a huge difference and helps your skin soak it up. Definitely recommend.

review_text: This product is just as it claims; rich and emollient. You can definitely feel the oils. It’s almost like applying an oily, thinner version of Vaseline and I mean that in a good way. I have only been using this for about a week but I think this might be breaking me out a little bit. I keep waking up to these small whiteheads on my chin, so just a heads up if you are acne prone like me. This is really unfortunate because I have been loving this moisturizer. I am taking a break for a week to let my skin return back to normal and then I will give it one my try to make sure. I have a lot of Skinfix products and all of the packaging tends to feel very basic, but this jar has some substance to it. I also appreciate how it dispenses product, so that I don’t have to stick my fingers in a jar. Feels way more sanitary. full_text: Do not recommend for dry skin, refill package suck. I got the full size + refill as a package over Christmas. My skin has changed for the first time to being dry on the lower half of my face. Not too bad to the point of flaking, but it feels dry and tight. I bought this to combat that, but it doesn’t. It feels nice on the skin, but after an hour, my skin is dry again. I end up having to layer different moisturizers on. This might work for more normal skin, not dry.I HATE the packaging. The press top is innovative and fun, but it’s less sanitary than a regular pump. I tried to put the replacement cartridge in and this is when everything went downhill. The pump no longer works and I have to pull apart the packaging and dip my fingers into the pot (which I don’t mind) but because it’s not made to be used like this, it’s incredibly messy.For the price, I don’t want to just throw it away, but I cannot wait to be done with this product and never use it again.

review_text: I am so impressed with this cream. First of all, it’s formulated without fragrance, which is so unnecessary in any skincare. It also doesn’t have a bunch of fillers like silicones so you are really getting higher concentrations of hydrators and extracts. Also, it has one of the push applicators there release just the right amount of product which is way more hygienic than a tub and protects the actives in the formula from being oxidized early. I really appreciate how much thought skinfix puts into their formulations and packaging, and think this helps make the higher price point more reasonable. That being said, this is definitely on the pricier side. I do think it’s worth it, because a little goes a lot way, it’s super nourishing and you’re getting some really effective ingredients to support the skin barrier.

full_text: Oily skin.This repaired my damage skin in 2 nights. This moisturizer saved my damaged skin in 2 nights. I damaged my moisture barrier by using too many exfoliating products to combat oiliness. Everything I put on my face was burning. I remembered I had picked up one the minis for this a while ago and decided to give it a try. I just added this moisturizer in place of my regular moisturizer without changing anything in my routine. The next day my face was glowing and the sensitivity has calmed down. The next day (2 nights after) there was no sensitivity and just loved how my face is glowing and it helps keep my oiliness under control throughout the day after. I immediately ordered the $60 deal for this with the refill and hand cream (still available at Kohl’s). I will always have this as my repair moisturizer in my corner. Thanks Skinfix, I never knew oily skin babes like me can also benefit from thick creams but now I know. Please if you’re reading this, get it. It may feel greasy at first but you’ll love the results the next morning.

review_text: Although I think the quality of this product is good and actually works well, I am incredibly disappointed by how much plastic I am actually paying for vs the actual product. The bottle is large in comparison to other moisturizes but when you crackdown to the bottom of the bottle you realize it consists of mostly wasted plastic which is bad for our environment. Why am I paying this much money for plastic? During this time when most of us are at home, I realized my moisturizer was on the low end, but since the bottle is so heavy I couldn’t tell if there was more at the bottom, or it was the weight of the bottle that I was feeling. After dismantling the bottle with the help of my partner out of desperation for a few more drops I realized that the bottle seems to be filled with %60 percent plastic and %40 product, or perhaps less. I was actually infuriated. WHAT A RIP OFF!!! While the product is not bad and I would have considered using it again, I have to wonder what type of company does this? DO BETTER DRUNK ELEPHANT! I am disappointed and I will not be purchasing again.

review_text: I’m surprised by the negative reviews this product has gotten since I’m now obsessed with it. I have dry skin (truly dry) all year long, and this is a lifesaver for me. This was recommended to me by a Sephora employee, who thought my other products I’ve used (Dr. Jart Ceramidin, Summer Fridays Jet Lag) were good choices, but this product beats them. My skin drinks this right up, and leaves me with incredibly soft baby skin. I also love the packaging from DE (the pump) and that even with all of the oils this doesn’t feel too heavy for my skin, even in the summer. I personally don’t notice a smell at all with this product, so I can’t comment on the neg reviews for that. I would highly recommend this product if you have dry skin like mine that needs a thicker moisturizer, otherwise try my other HG moisturizer, the Dr. Jart Ceramidin cream mentioned previously.

review_text: I absolutely must have this moisturizer at all times, and I’ve always had one since Drunk Elephant only had a small handful of products back in 2017. I must be on my 4th or 5th jar now. I use this on days I feel dry, and it just does the job. Flaking, using retinol, or using AHA or BHA, just use this on top, and your face will no longer be dry. I use it more in the winter than summer, but I would use it before going to sleep on dry, summer days. A friend of mine said it stings when she uses this, but It hasn’t stung at all for me. I love how it is unscented, too, and the packaging. I don’t like open jars, since I feel like the ingredients get too much exposure to the air, but this jar is a pump jar! I can’t live without this unless I live in a humid, tropical climate. Highly recommend.

review_text: This product was my absolute BFF for my extremely dry skin throughout the winter.The ceramides and oils in it help with overall hydration, moisture barrier protection, and just keeping my skin happy.The dispenser, as in all of DE’s products, is one of my favorite things about this product. One pump and that’s all you need for your face. One more pump for your neck and décolletage. Bam! Done and you don’t waste any product.Downside to the way this product is packaged: can’t see when it is close to empty and sometimes there are air pockets within the cream which make the pump action kind of sputter; this leads you to thinking that you’re out. The weight of the product is arguably deceptive as well (unless you accurately weighed it new, converted the weight of 1.69 fl oz to grams, and then every time it sputtered you weighed it again to see if you were close to empty or actually at empty), as the mechanism for pumping is actually kind of heavy and the tub is double insulated -- which leads to imprecise “hand-weighing“.I’ve purchased Lala Retro 3 times, I believe, and only noticed these issues with weight and possible air bubbles vs. actually being empty with the most recent purchase. This leads me to wonder if I’ve accidentally thrown out precious, precious Lala cream before...At $1.2 per ml, this is actually one of the better deals you can get within the Drunk Elephant line, AND it is an excellent moisturizer. It also lasts a really long time, if you limit yourself to 1x/day applications, using only 1-2 pumps per day.I’m only giving it 4 stars because of the weight issue and because I have since found a cheaper moisturizer + facial oil combination which, total, is cheaper than just this one product and is as effective.I still love you DE.

review_text: Let me start off by saying I LOVE this moisturizer!! I think Protini has my heart just because I’ve been using that one a while, but this is really giving it a run for its money!! I’ll do a bit of a comparison then go into further detail on Lala Retro on its own. Protini feels more like lotion consistency - a little more airy/less dense, goes on so smoothly onto your skin, and makes your skin feel a little more plump. Lala Retro in comparison feels thicker and denser, still goes on smoothly onto your skin but I feel the desire to rub it in a little more, and it makes your skin feel HYDRATED. It’s good stuff. I’m really liking it right now in the winter. I’m loving the way it’s making my skin feel - it feels like it was thirsty for some hydration and then Lala Retro gave it what it needed. I’m super happy with it. It’s the same type of packaging and size as Protini, for reference. This stuff is good y’all!! I feel like I’ll switch back and forth between the two moving forward or I might even mix the two. You won’t regret trying this out! Highly recommend.

review_text: OMG SILK BUTTER! This is one of those push down pumps where the cream comes out of the middle. I have a love hate with these designs— I love that it’s different & I feel fancy from every other tube/bottle but I’m also always thinking I’m missing out on tons of product I can’t see once it’s empty. That being said, I am in love with this moisturizer!!! It is so so sooo silky smooth on my skin & I feel like I’m shoving moisture into my skin. I tend to have sensitive skin even after washing my face to the point that it’s red & irritated so some moisturizing products can actually cause a burning sensation for a few minutes after application.  I don’t have any of that when then goes on! Just a smooth feel that makes me actually WANT to apply this regularly!  I’ve used it a few times now and so far I’m a fan & would consider sticking with this as my main moisturizer, but I’d need a travel size alternative! I would say this would be a good option for ANY SKIN TYPE!

full_text: For Very Dry Skin Users Only. This is a great product, but I will not be purchasing this item again only because my skin isn’t dry enough to need this. This product is incredibly moisturizing. If you have skin that has a hard time locking in moisture then this will be a great option for you. Once applied it feels like a face mask because it is so thick and creamy. It doesn’t absorb quickly into the skin like I prefer my moisturizers to. I bought this to try instead of the Tatcha water cream because I’ve been reading that you don’t want to expose your moisturizers to air and light. This moisturizer comes with a fancy pump lid to make sure it isn’t exposed to elements. Again- great option if you have very dry skin.

review_text: I had tried the original version of this moisturizer and really liked it but when I saw they reformulated I was intrigued. I do lean more oily but wanted this for nighttime. I have been using it every night for over a week and I can already tell my skin barrier is stronger and my skin just feels overall firmer and softer. The added the ceramides in this I think is contributing to the great results! With fall and winter coming I will probably use this during the day as well. It is not oily, just really substantial and totally worth it IMO! Dare I say this is my new favorite!

review_text: I absolutely love this moisturizer. I have oily -  but this is so light weight - truly like whipped cream in its consistency with a gel like undertone- that it absorbs beautifully leaving my skin supple, soft and moisturized without leaving a film or sheen. It is really not thick at all as some people are saying. I add a few drops of marula oil for after i use the sukari babyfacial and after my hydration serums and essences in order to lock in the moisture. Marula is a dry oil so again despite my oily skin, I can use it without breaking out.  You see best results with this using it on properly exfoliated and hydrated skin. You cant just slap this on after washing the face. You have to hydrate and moisturize in layers and wait for each step to absorb before adding this as a final step in you skincare routine. Because i have oily skin, I dont need to use this during the day. I use it at night and I actually wake up without the usual film of oil on my skin.
